subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should this already-public transcript terminal-control issue proceed as a normal public CLI hardening fix, or be routed through OpenClaw security handling before repair?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the bug lets untrusted imported transcript text emit terminal controls through an operator-facing CLI path and the issue already carries security-review routing labels.

options.title: Proceed With Public Hardening Fix
options.body: Treat the already-public, limited-blast-radius terminal-control injection as a normal CLI security-hardening bug and require focused regression coverage before close.

options.title: Route Through Security Triage First
options.body: Pause repair work until security reviewers decide whether this needs advisory-style handling despite already being public.
